/*  Turn on the Large File Support when *IFS64IO is specified   @A8A*/
/*  as C compiler option.                                       @A8A*/

   #endif                                                    /* @A8A*/

   #endif                                                    /* @A8A*/

/*********************************************************************/
/* Definitions of File Modes and File Types                          */
/*********************************************************************/

#ifndef S_IRUSR
   #define S_IRUSR 0000400    /* Read for owner                      */
#endif

#ifndef S_IWUSR
   #define S_IWUSR 0000200    /* Write for owner                     */
#endif

#ifndef S_IXUSR
   #define S_IXUSR 0000100    /* Execute and Search for owner        */
#endif

#ifndef S_IRWXU
   #define S_IRWXU (S_IRUSR|S_IWUSR|S_IXUSR)  /* Read, Write,
                                                 Execute for owner   */
#endif

#ifndef S_IRGRP
   #define S_IRGRP 0000040         /* Read for group                 */
#endif

#ifndef S_IWGRP
   #define S_IWGRP 0000020         /* Write for group                */
#endif

#ifndef S_IXGRP
   #define S_IXGRP 0000010         /* Execute and Search for group   */
#endif

#ifndef S_IRWXG
   #define S_IRWXG (S_IRGRP|S_IWGRP|S_IXGRP)  /* Read, Write,
                                                 Execute for group   */
#endif

#ifndef S_IROTH
   #define S_IROTH 0000004         /* Read for other                 */
#endif

#ifndef S_IWOTH
   #define S_IWOTH 0000002         /* Write for other                */
#endif

#ifndef S_IXOTH
   #define S_IXOTH 0000001         /* Execute and Search for other   */
#endif

#ifndef S_IRWXO
   #define S_IRWXO (S_IROTH|S_IWOTH|S_IXOTH)  /* Read, Write,
                                                 Execute for other   */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISUID                                               /* @A9A*/
   #define S_ISUID 0004000         /* Set user ID on execution   @A9A*/
#endif                                                        /* @A9A*/

#ifndef S_ISGID                                               /* @A9A*/
   #define S_ISGID 0002000         /* Set group ID on execution  @A9A*/
#endif                                                        /* @A9A*/

/* Protect POSIX source                                          @B6A*/
#if  ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
      || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))
#ifndef S_ISVTX                                               /* @B6A*/
   #define S_ISVTX 0001000         /* Restricted rename          @B6A*/
                                   /* and unlink                 @B6A*/
#endif                                                        /* @B6A*/
/* Protect POSIX source                                          @B6A*/
#endif

#define _S_IFFIFO   0010000     /* FIFO                              */
#define _S_IFCHR    0020000     /* character special                 */
#define _S_IFDIR    0040000     /* Directory                         */
#define _S_IFBLK    0060000     /* block special                     */
#define _S_IFREG    0100000     /* Regular file                      */
#define _S_IFLNK    0120000     /* Symbolic link                     */
#define _S_IFSOCK   0140000     /* Socket                            */
#define _S_IFNATIVE 0200000     /* AS/400 native object              */

#ifndef S_ISDIR
   #define S_ISDIR(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFDIR) /* Test for
                                                        directory    */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISREG
   #define S_ISREG(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFREG) /* Test for
                                                        regular file */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISLNK
   #define S_ISLNK(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFLNK) /* Test for
                                                        symbolic link*/
#endif

#ifndef S_ISSOCK
   #define S_ISSOCK(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFSOCK)
                                           /* Test for socket */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISNATIVE
   #define S_ISNATIVE(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFNATIVE)
                                      /* Test for AS/400 native
                                         object                    */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISFIFO
   #define S_ISFIFO(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFFIFO)
                                      /* Test for FIFO special     */
#endif

#ifndef S_ISCHR
   #define S_ISCHR(m)   (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFCHR)
                                      /* Test for Character special*/
#endif

#ifndef S_ISBLK
   #define S_ISBLK(m)  (((m) & 0370000) == _S_IFBLK)
                                      /* Test for Block special    */
#endif

/*******************************************************************/
/* _64_BIT_TIME is not defined before 7.2, and is dependent on     */
/* the definition of time64_t.                                     */
/*******************************************************************/
#if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__<720) || !(defined __time64_t))       /* @B8A*/
#undef _64_BIT_TIME                                         /* @B8A*/
#endif                                                      /* @B8A*/

struct stat {
/*******************************************************************/
/* If neither _LARGE_FILES nor _64_BIT_TIME is defined, then we    */
/* declare the stat structure with 32-bit sizes and times.         */
/*******************************************************************/
#if (!(defined _LARGE_FILES) && !(defined _64_BIT_TIME))    /* @B8C*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_reserved2;  /* Reserved                    @B4A*/
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off_t          st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time_t         st_atime;      /* Time of last access             */
  time_t         st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification  */
  time_t         st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change */
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  unsigned long  st_allocsize;  /* Allocation size of the file     */
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved3;  /* Reserved                    @B4A*/
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid           @AAA*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)      @B4A*/
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit      @B5C*/
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form     @B4A*/
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                @B4A*/
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.   @B7A*/
  char           st_reserved1[32]; /* Reserved            @B4A @B7C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[56]; /* Reserved                 @B4C*/
#endif
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id
                                                               @A2A*/
/*******************************************************************/
/* If _LARGE_FILES is defined, but not _64_BIT_TIME, then we       */
/* declare the stat structure with 64-bit sizes and 32-bit times,  */
/* laid out exactly like the stat64 structure                      */
/*******************************************************************/
#else /* Not standard stat structure                           @B8C*/
#ifndef _64_BIT_TIME /* Map to stat64 structure                @B8A*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off_t          st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time_t         st_atime;      /* Time of last access             */
  time_t         st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification  */
  time_t         st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change */
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned long long st_allocsize; /* Allocation size of the file  */
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id
                                                               @A2A*/
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved2[5]; /* Reserved                  @B4A*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)      @B4A*/
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form     @B4A*/
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                @B4A*/
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit      @B5A*/
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.   @B7A*/
  char           st_reserved1[22]; /* Reserved       @B4A @B5C @B7C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[46]; /* Reserved                 @B4C*/
#endif
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid           @AAA*/
/*******************************************************************/
/* If _64_BIT_TIME is defined, then we declare the stat structure  */
/* with 64-bit sizes and 64-bit times, laid out exactly like the   */
/* stat64_time64 structure                                         */
/*******************************************************************/
#else /* map to stat64_time64 structure                        @B8A*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off64_t        st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time64_t       st_atime;      /* Time of last access         @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification
                                                               @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change
                                                               @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id*/
  unsigned long long st_allocsize; /* Allocation size of the file  */
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved2[1]; /* Reserved                  @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)          */
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form         */
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                    */
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit          */
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.       */
  char           st_reserved1[14]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[38]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#endif
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid               */
#endif /* map to stat64_time64 structure                       @B8A*/
#endif /* map to stat64 structure                                  */
};

/*******************************************************************/
/* stat64 structure for _LARGE_FILE_API support.               @A6A*/
/*******************************************************************/
#ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                      /* @A6A*/
struct stat64 {
/*******************************************************************/
/* If _64_BIT_TIME is not defined, then we declare the stat64      */
/* structure with 64-bit sizes and 32-bit times.                   */
/*******************************************************************/
#ifndef _64_BIT_TIME                                        /* @B8A*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off64_t        st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time_t         st_atime;      /* Time of last access             */
  time_t         st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification  */
  time_t         st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change */
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned long long st_allocsize; /* Allocation size of the file  */
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id
                                                               @A2A*/
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved2[5]; /* Reserved                  @B4A*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)      @B4A*/
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form     @B4A*/
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                @B4A*/
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit      @B5A*/
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.   @B7A*/
  char           st_reserved1[22]; /* Reserved       @B4A @B5C @B7C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[46]; /* Reserved                 @B4C*/
#endif
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid           @AAA*/
/*******************************************************************/
/* If _64_BIT_TIME is defined, then we declare the stat64          */
/* structure with 64-bit sizes and 64-bit times, laid out exactly  */
/* like the stat64_time64 structure                                */
/*******************************************************************/
#else  /* map to stat64_time64 structure                       @B8A*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off64_t        st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time64_t       st_atime;      /* Time of last access         @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification
                                                               @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change
                                                               @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id*/
  unsigned long long st_allocsize; /* Allocation size of the file  */
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved2[1]; /* Reserved                  @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)          */
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form         */
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                    */
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit          */
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.       */
  char           st_reserved1[14]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[38]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#endif
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid               */
#endif /* map to stat64_time64 structure                       @B8A*/
};

#if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))       /* @B8A*/
/*******************************************************************/
/* stat64_time64 structure for 64-bit size and time support.   @B8A*/
/*******************************************************************/
struct stat64_time64 {                                      /* @B8A*/
  mode_t         st_mode;       /* File mode                       */
  ino_t          st_ino;        /* File serial number              */
  uid_t          st_uid;        /* User ID of the owner of file    */
  gid_t          st_gid;        /* Group ID of the group of file   */
  off64_t        st_size;       /* For regular files, the file
                                   size in bytes                   */
  time64_t       st_atime;      /* Time of last access         @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_mtime;      /* Time of last data modification
                                                               @B8C*/
  time64_t       st_ctime;      /* Time of last file status change
                                                               @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_dev;        /* ID of device containing file    */
  size_t         st_blksize;    /* Size of a block of the file     */
  nlink_t        st_nlink;      /* Number of links                 */
  unsigned short st_codepage;   /* Object data codepage            */
  unsigned int   st_ino_gen_id; /* File serial number generation id*/
  unsigned long long st_allocsize; /* Allocation size of the file  */
  qp0l_objtype_t st_objtype;    /* AS/400 object type              */
  char           st_reserved2[1]; /* Reserved                  @B8C*/
  dev_t          st_rdev;       /* Device ID (if character special */
                                /* or block special file)          */
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  dev64_t        st_rdev64;     /* Device ID - 64 bit form         */
  dev64_t        st_dev64;      /* ID of device containing file -  */
                                /* 64 bit form.                    */
  nlink32_t      st_nlink32;    /* Number of links-32 bit          */
  unsigned int   st_vfs;        /* Unique mount ID of the file sys */
                                /*  containing the object. Use     */
                                /*  QP0LFLOP() to get more info on */
                                /*  the mounted file system.       */
  char           st_reserved1[14]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#else
  char           st_reserved1[38]; /* Reserved                 @B8C*/
#endif
  unsigned short st_ccsid;      /* Object data ccsid               */
};
#endif                          /* Target is 7.2 or later      @B8A*/

#endif                          /* _LARGE_FILE_API defined     @A6A*/

/*******************************************************************/
/* function prototypes                                             */
/*******************************************************************/
QBFC_EXTERN int chmod(const char *, mode_t);

/*******************************************************************/
/* APIs mapping for large file support                         @A6A*/
/* Map 32 bit version APIs to 64 bit version if _LARGE_FILES   @A6A*/
/* macro is used by the applications.                          @A6A*/
/*******************************************************************/
#if ((defined _LARGE_FILES) && \
     (!(defined _64_BIT_TIME) || (__OS400_TGTVRM__<720)))   /* @B8C*/
#pragma map (fstat, "fstat64")                         /* @A6A @A7C*/
#pragma map (lstat, "lstat64")                         /* @A6A @A7C*/
#pragma map (stat, "stat64")                           /* @A6A @A7C*/
                                                           /* @B1A */
#if  ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
      || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))
  #pragma map (QlgLstat, "QlgLstat64")                      /* @B1A*/
  #pragma map (QlgStat, "QlgStat64")                        /* @B1A*/
 #endif                                                     /* @B1A*/
#endif                                                      /* @A6A*/

/*******************************************************************/
/* API mapping for 64-bit time support. Map all APIs to 64-bit     */
/* time versions if _64_BIT_TIME is defined and target release     */
/* is 7.2 or later.                                                */
/*******************************************************************/
#if ((defined _64_BIT_TIME) && (__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720))     /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (fstat, "fstat64_time64")                       /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (lstat, "lstat64_time64")                       /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (stat, "stat64_time64")                         /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (fstat64, "fstat64_time64")                     /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (lstat64, "lstat64_time64")                     /* @B8A*/
#pragma map (stat64, "stat64_time64")                       /* @B8A*/
#if  ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
      || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))
  #pragma map (QlgLstat, "QlgLstat64_time64")               /* @B8A*/
  #pragma map (QlgStat, "QlgStat64_time64")                 /* @B8A*/
  #pragma map (QlgLstat64, "QlgLstat64_time64")             /* @B8A*/
  #pragma map (QlgStat64, "QlgStat64_time64")               /* @B8A*/
 #endif                                                     /* @B8A*/
#endif                                                      /* @B8A*/


/* not POSIX.1 defined API */
#if (!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE))
  QBFC_EXTERN int fchmod(int, mode_t);
#endif

QBFC_EXTERN int fstat(int, struct stat *);

#ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                      /* @A6A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int fstat64(int, struct stat64 *);            /* @A6A*/
  #if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))     /* @B8A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int fstat64_time64(int,
                                 struct stat64_time64 *);   /* @B8A*/
  #endif                                                    /* @B8A*/
#endif                                                      /* @A6A*/

/* POSIX.1a defined API */
#if  ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
      || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))
  QBFC_EXTERN int lstat(const char *, struct stat *);

  #ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                      /* @A6A*/
    QBFC_EXTERN int lstat64(const char *, struct stat64 *);   /* @A6A*/
    #if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))     /* @B8A*/
    QBFC_EXTERN int lstat64_time64(const char *,
                                   struct stat64_time64 *);   /* @B8A*/
    #endif                                                    /* @B8A*/
  #endif                                                      /* @A6A*/
#endif

QBFC_EXTERN int mkdir(const char *, mode_t);
QBFC_EXTERN int stat(const char *, struct stat *);
QBFC_EXTERN mode_t umask(mode_t);
QBFC_EXTERN int mkfifo(const char *, mode_t);                 /* @B3A*/

#ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                       /* @A6A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int stat64(const char *, struct stat64 *);     /* @A6A*/
  #if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))      /* @B8A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int stat64_time64(const char *,
                                struct stat64_time64 *);     /* @B8A*/
  #endif                                                     /* @B8A*/
#endif                                                       /* @A6A*/

/* POSIX.1a defined API */                                     /*@B1A*/
#if ((!(defined _POSIX_SOURCE) && !(defined _POSIX1_SOURCE)) \
    || ((defined _POSIX1_SOURCE) && (_POSIX1_SOURCE != 1)))    /*@B1A*/

  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgChmod(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *, mode_t);   /*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgMkdir(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *, mode_t);   /*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgStat(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,struct stat *);/*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgLstat(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,struct stat *);/*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgMkfifo(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,mode_t);  /* @B3A*/

 #ifdef _LARGE_FILE_API                                        /*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgLstat64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,          /*@B1A*/
                                struct stat64 *);              /*@B1A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgStat64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,           /*@B1A*/
                                struct stat64 *);              /*@B1A*/
  #if ((__OS400_TGTVRM__>=720) && (defined __time64_t))       /* @B8A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgLstat64_time64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,
                                    struct stat64_time64 *);  /* @B8A*/
  QBFC_EXTERN int QlgStat64_time64(const Qlg_Path_Name_T *,
                                   struct stat64_time64 *);   /* @B8A*/
  #endif                                                      /* @B8A*/
 #endif                                                        /*@B1A*/
#endif                                                         /*@B1A*/

#pragma datamodel(pop)                                        /* @B2A*/
